The balance sheet is very highly leveraged (liabilities are about 93% of assets, with equity only about 7% of assets) and liquidity is weak (current ratio 0.83), which is not consistent with strong investment-grade credit quality on the figures alone. While the company is profitable and has substantial retained earnings, EBIT is small relative to the asset and liability base, supporting a speculative-grade but not distressed assessment.

DECISION: BB-
